description: Estimates the Cyprus state (contributory) pension amount at retirement using official contribution schedules and current 2026 pension income-tax bands, based on accumulated insurance units and contribution history. Use to estimate contributory Cyprus state pension entitlement and amount at retirement. Results apply the current 2026 pension income-tax bands; projected contribution amounts use the published SI rate increases in 2029, 2034 and 2039. Reuse supplied facts and ask only for missing essentials: mode and retirement age are always required; quick mode also needs current age, years worked and total insurance units; advanced mode needs the actual non-empty yearly contribution record. Ask for dependants or state the zero-dependants assumption before presenting a personalized result. Never infer contribution history or eligibility facts. Missing insurance-statement facts leave qualifiesForPension null and a conditional amount estimate; special/cross-border routes require assessment. Units are per calendar year; a legacy year-to-units map is accepted.

dependentSpouse.description: Confirmed eligibility for a dependent-spouse pension increase; not merely married.

dependents.description: Legacy estimated dependant count. It cannot identify an eligible spouse; use dependentSpouse and otherDependents for the statutory tier.

actualBasicInsurancePoints.description: Actual paid basic insurance points at claim date; credited points do not satisfy the actual-points condition.

referencePeriodYears.description: Reference period from the insurance statement, including applicable statutory exclusions.

standardDomesticCase.description: Confirm the ordinary domestic route, without special invalidity, miner or cross-border provisions. False or omitted leaves eligibility undetermined.

totalBasicInsurancePoints.description: Paid plus credited BASIC points, not total basic-plus-supplementary insurance units.

otherDependents.description: Other confirmed eligible dependants; increase is capped at two. Supply with dependentSpouse for an exact dependant tier.

totalInsuranceUnits.description: Actual accumulated Cyprus insurance units/points (quick mode); do not infer from salary or years worked.

yearlyUnits.description: Advanced mode only. Insurance units earned per calendar year, e.g. [{"year":2003,"units":5.2}]. Units per year must be between 0 and the statutory maximum for that year (about 5.3-6.0; 6.0 for years after 2026). A legacy object map {"2003": 5.2} is also accepted. Years worked and total units are derived from this array, so yearsWorked/totalInsuranceUnits are ignored in advanced mode.

yearsWorked.description: Actual years with insurance contributions (quick mode); do not infer from age or employment duration.

name: calculate_cyprus_state_pension
